json.notes: Three biggest differences: (1) the dome is a tall, pointed bullet shape; the real Panthéon dome is a low lead hemisphere on a drum, with a small lantern and cross on top, so I lower the dome and raise the drum. (2) The portico reads as a solid flat-topped box with its pediment hidden; the real front is a deep free-standing Corinthian colonnade under a visible triangular pediment, so I model it as a colonnade with a pediment in front of a plainer nave wall. (3) The transept arms and rear nave have windows over their full height; the real flanks have tall arched windows only on the lower storey, with a plain pilastered wall above, and the rear nave is blank with festoons, so I limit the windows accordingly.
